description: Every known vulnerability in one open source package, most urgent first, with the affected ranges and fixed versions published for that package. Give a version to learn which advisories affect it and the lowest upgrade that leaves every affecting range.

ecosystem.description: npm, PyPI, Maven, Go, crates.io, RubyGems, Packagist, NuGet, Hex or Pub.

name.description: The package name, such as lodash, django, org.apache.logging.log4j:log4j-core or golang.org/x/net.

only_affected.description: With version, list only the advisories that affect it.

version.description: Optional exact version to check, such as 4.17.20.

name: get_package

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor, with the same arguments, for the next page.

version.description: The version check, when a version was given: affected_by, not_comparable, no_fix_listed and upgrade_to.

title: Look up a package
